description: List the operations, tools and skills of one API, MCP server or agent (paged). Use to find the exact call to make. Filter by group, kind, HTTP method or text; can show older versions or removed items.

group.description: Only items in this group or tag, exactly as listed in the response `groups`, e.g. "Billing".

method.description: Only REST operations with this HTTP method.

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for paging (default 0).

q.description: Words to find in item names, summaries, groups and paths, e.g. "refund".

removed.description: Include items that were removed in the latest crawl (default false).

slug.description: The entity's slug, as returned in search results (field `slug`), e.g. "mcp-hundily-com-63b5e97c".

sort.description: Sort order: group (default, as published), name (A to Z) or method.

version.description: Show the items as they were at this older version number (see get_entity_versions). Omit for the latest.

name: get_capabilities
